ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = ME-01
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********
Recently a security terminal was illegally accessed using a unique custom cryptokey that had been utilized in a heist last year by one Oslo Arlington, the younger sibling of gang leader Maltrox Arlington. While we we’re unable to positively confirm if the terminal was hacked by Oslo or not, we feel it is worth investigating.
Extremely intelligent, tech savvy and a renowned strategist, Oslo has proven difficult to capture in the past. If this lead does result in finding Oslo, a well coordinated tactical strike team would be advantageous to a successful engagement.
You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 差事

合约类型：集体逮捕令
合约状态：独立
授权代码 = [CONTRACTOR]

需要立即处理

*********
__背景信息__
臭名昭著的阿灵顿帮居然试图从一个修船厂中盗窃一艘伊德里斯级护卫舰，作为回应，他们每个人都在这一份集体逮捕令中。这次盗窃被阻止了，那群渣滓落荒而逃，分开躲进了黑暗中。皆是是无胆鼠辈，大难临头各自飞。埃克哈特安保收到了一份对阿灵顿帮高级成员的即时赏金逮捕令。成员包括：马尔特克斯·阿灵顿，卡斯·登特，尼克斯·坎特威尔，萨姆“爱哭鬼”阿灵顿，奥斯陆·阿灵顿和莱斯·阿灵顿。
*********

我们最近得知，有人使用一组自定义加密密钥非法破解并访问了一个安全终端，而这组自定义密钥在去年曾经被阿灵顿帮领导人马尔特克斯·阿灵顿的一个名为奥斯陆·阿灵顿的“年轻有为”的小弟用于一次抢劫活动中。尽管这次入侵可能并不是奥斯陆本人所为，但这次非法访问仍然值得我们调查。

 尽管是个恶棍，但不得不承认，奥斯陆的确十分有才。他极其聪明，精通各种现金技术的使用且善于编写代码。过去几次对他的抓捕行动都以失败告终。如果这次入侵的确是奥斯陆本人所为，那么我们建议你组织一队装备精良且训练有素的小队对目标进行突击，速战速决，免得这家伙又跑了。

你被授权使用任何必要的火力，枪炮刀剑都无所谓，把他干掉。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

1uqxrh0.description_en:
To all available contractors,
We at Rayari are dedicating all our energy to stopping the regeneration technology crisis in its tracks, but for our scientists to continue their efforts they need resources that the company's suppliers have been unable to deliver.
There is a sizeable population of kopions that have been exposed to radiation near [LOCATION]. Rayari is seeking an contractor to collect irradiated kopion horns and deliver them to [DESTINATION]. Due to the scarcity of this resource, we are prepared to pay a high service fee.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TARGET] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.
We're told you can find [TARGET] around [LOCATION]. Head over and take care of it.
They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.
Stows out.

Here’s the deal. Dead Saints need some new blood to help shift gear across the ’verse and if you can prove yourself useful, you could make some nice creds doing it.
Got an easy one to start you out. Couple of hours ago, something went down over at [LOCATION] and a pilot of mine got ghosted. My tracker’s telling me that they didn’t find the stash of gear in there.
If you can get out there, get the package back and take it to [DESTINATION] without dying, I might have some more work for you. Can’t see you running into too much trouble as any ships you spot will likely be scavs looking for a quick cred. I’m sure you can take care of that.
-Twitch

给你一个简单的任务作为开始。几个小时前，[LOCATION] 那边出了点状况，我的一名飞行员失踪了。我的追踪器显示他们没有找到那里的物资。

如果你能赶到那里，把包裹取回来并安全送到 [DESTINATION]，我可能会给你更多的任务。你应该不会遇到太大麻烦，因为你看到的任何飞船很可能都是那些想赚快钱的不法分子。我相信你能应付得来。

-刺痛

We have recently been alerted that one of our Oxygen Dispensers has suffered a technical error. As you know these kiosks are vital to ensure that you have plenty of oxygen handy while participating in our Work Release Program.

Thank you.

I’ve strung together a few potential spots that I’d set up in if I was gonna hit ‘em. Any chance you could visit and clear out any lowlifes that may be hiding there?
The route starts at the location marker on your HUD. After you scan it and clear whatever’s there, I’ll send you to a few other areas that could work. I’ve been hearing people have been rolling through these spots, so would be smart to bring a friend to watch your back.
You make it to the end and I'll give the main contractor a bonus 14 Council Scrip as thanks.
- Stows
69iar9.description_zh:
最近针对猎头帮飞船的袭击变多了，这让我感到不安。有批重要补给物资经不起闪失，得找人探路清场——我标了几个要是我就肯定会埋伏的点。

从你 HUD 上的位置标记开始扫荡，完事再发你下个坐标。听说这些地方最近总有杂碎晃悠，所以带上个朋友掩护你是个明智的选择。

只要你把这事办成，我就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为额外奖励。

- 斯托斯

14o3hia.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

10msw8n.description_en:
Crew managing one of our client's operations at [LOCATION] have reported that they're under attack from a criminal gang targeting the [OBJECTS] and ships in the area. It will be your job to keep both safe at all costs. I don't have all the facts yet, but I reckon this will be a tough mission – these outlaws seem determined to do some real carnage.
If it were me, I would <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. And if you manage to protect everyone, we’re offering a well-earned 4 MG Scrip to the main contractor who deals with these lowlife's successfully.
Best of luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

8prhq2.description_en:
It feels that whenever we start to make real progress in the system, the outlaws are there to push one step back. We had recently cleared out [LOCATION] only to learn that a new outlaw gang has taken root there, using it as a launching point for various criminal enterprises.
Since we can't afford to let this rot spread, you and a few support ships are being charged with heading there to clear out all the gang's packs. After you deal with one pack, be sure to wait until all of the hostile packs have been dealt with.

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

18sfqe2.description_en:
Hi,
Hurston is requesting that we prioritize pick ups from the local mining facilities to free up space for what they’re extracting. Here’s everywhere you need to go:
PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION1]
Once collected, everything needs to get to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. They've said that all the containers will be at most 4 SCU in size. Sound like something you could handle?
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
